user.title: Connect Chaptarr + Audiobookshelf
user.description: Credentials stay in Home Assistant; the books card never sees them.

data_description.abs_token: Token of a dedicated, restricted Audiobookshelf user (Settings → Users), not the admin
data_description.tolino_url: tolino-bridge address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8199. Leave empty to keep the share-sheet fallback.
data_description.tolino_token: Value of secrets/bridge_token (deploy.sh token on Unraid)
data_description.sync_progress: Imports the reading position and 'finished' state of books you sent to tolino into Audiobookshelf (and so the card), every 10 minutes. Only books sent through this integration; a newer Audiobookshelf state is never overwritten. Needs the tolino bridge. Off by default.
data_description.rescue_imports: Assigns downloads that Chaptarr blocks because of a same-series title mix-up to the book they were grabbed for
data_description.notify_service: Notify entity (e.g. notify.iphone_von_max) or notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_iphone_von_max); separate several with commas. Notified when an automatic repair fails.
data_description.debug_logging: Logs every proxied request at debug level
